metadata.title: Nigella Lawson - Ed's Victorious Turkey Hash
metadata.description:
Nigella Lawson - Ed's Victorious Turkey Hash
This turkey has recipe, given to me by my friend and agent, Ed Victor, and in charmingly bossy letter form, has been a recurring feature in my books. Why drop it now of all times? Not least, of course, because it is a real winner.

Ive given it here as an actual recipe but, as with all these notions for left-overs, the quantities are meant to be a guide only. They are more of the a handful of this, a handful of that school of cookery, and thats how it should be.

Anyway, this is my adaptation of the Victor original: Ive fiddled a bit, but remained essentially faithful, as, indeed, I will always be to him.
Yield: Serves 2 hungry people as a main course, or 4 with a baked potato and a green salad to go alongside
Ingredients

    * 1/3 cup sliced almonds
    * 1 tablespoon butter
    * 2 tablespoons olive oil
    * 1 onion, peeled and chopped
    * 2 red bell peppers, seeded and chopped into approx. ½ x 3/4 inch pieces
    * 1 clove garlic, peeled and minced
    * 2 cups shredded cold turkey
    * 2/3 cups pitted black olives
    * 2 tablespoons sour cream
    * 2 tablespoons leftover turkey broth
    * 1 egg
    * Few dashes of Tabasco sauce, or to taste
    * Heaping ¾ cup shaved Parmesan cheese
    * 1-2 tablespoons chopped Italian flat leaf parsley to garnish (optional)

Directions

1. Toss the sliced almonds in a hot, dry skillet over a medium to high heat until toasted. Remove to a plate for a while.

2. Add the butter and oil to the skillet, then throw in the chopped onions and peppers and cook, stirring, over a medium to low heat for about 10 minutes.

3. Stir in the garlic, then add the shredded turkey and cook until piping hot.

4. Return the reserved toasted sliced almonds to the pan, add the olives and mix in.

5. Whisk together the sour cream, turkey broth and egg, then pour into the pan, give a quick stir to combine and shake in the Tabasco sauce.

6. Finally, add the shaved Parmesan and stir until it begins to melt into the hash.

7. On serving, sprinkle with chopped parsley, if wished.

Two people are initially shown sitting behind a desk. Then the clip cuts to two people mixing ingredients in some cast iron pans.
The scene then cuts again to a clip of the same two people putting the pans into the oven and removing them. Next, they both have a plate of what they just made and they each put a fork in their plate.

summary.brief: Nigella Lawson and a male co‑host prepare Ed’s Victorious Turkey Hash on a studio set.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a brief news‑studio introduction, then moves to the kitchen where the pair first toast sliced almonds in a dry cast‑iron skillet and set them aside. Butter and olive oil are added to the same pan, and chopped onion and red bell pepper are sautéed until softened. Minced garlic is added briefly so it sweats without browning, after which shredded cold turkey is stirred in and heated through. The toasted almonds and pitted black olives are returned to the pan. In a separate bowl, sour cream, turkey broth, a beaten egg and a dash of Tabasco are whisked together and poured over the hash, then quickly mixed. Shaved Parmesan cheese is sprinkled in and allowed to melt. The pan is placed briefly in the oven, removed, and the finished hash is plated; both cooks then taste it with forks.

action.detailed: Toast almonds, sauté onion and pepper in butter and oil, add garlic then shredded turkey, stir in olives, whisk sour‑cream, broth, egg and Tabasco and pour into the pan, melt Parmesan, bake briefly, then plate and serve.
action.actor: Nigella Lawson and the male co‑host

summary.brief: Nigella Lawson and her co‑host stir, season and plate a festive turkey hash in a studio kitchen.
summary.detailed: The segment opens on a holiday‑themed magazine cover before cutting to a bright studio kitchen where two large black pans sit on the stovetop. Nigella, wearing a long‑sleeved green top, adds butter and olive oil, then sautés chopped onion and red bell pepper over medium heat. She follows with minced garlic, taking care not to let it brown, and folds in shredded cold turkey until the mixture is piping hot. Pitted black olives and toasted sliced almonds (visible on a side plate) are returned to the pan, and a dash of Tabasco sauce is sprinkled in for heat. Shaved Parmesan cheese is sprinkled over the hash and allowed to melt, giving the dish a glossy finish. The camera follows the pair as they turn toward a decorated shelf, pick up plates, and neatly plate the hash, each taking a forkful and smiling while a scrolling news ticker runs at the bottom of the screen.

     with clear physical goals: assembly/disassembly, repair, crafting,
     tool use, packing, sorting. The video must show clear procedural
     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
